name: Sunshine
description: Sunshine streams games and graphical desktops to Moonlight clients using hardware video encoding. It provides a web interface for applications, credentials and client pairing.

notes.text: Wait for sunshine-firstboot.service, then reboot the guest. Sign in with your Cloud-Init user (debian by default).
GPU output needs a monitor/dummy. Dummy-only operation requires VM_DESKTOP_AUTOLOGIN=yes; GPU output is unavailable in noVNC.
After graphical login, open https://<vm-ip>:47990 and set credentials. Pegasus is an optional alpha build.
